data.content_ref: inline:The target proposes 'procedural convention' as the substantive relation but fails to define what this mechanism specifically IS in terms of dependence, reduction, shared mechanism, compatibility, inheritance, integration, contradiction, or abstraction. It merely labels the relation without stating its nature, violating the requirement to 'name its kind'. Furthermore, the 'REFUTED IF' condition describes a failure mode of the decision postulate (collapsing into inductive justification) rather than defining the endpoints of the relation or how the integration mechanically functions, rendering the proposed relation an unsupported assertion rather than a substantiated link.
